letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still smile thinking of our wedding day on 23 Feb—how the world seemed to pause just for us. You are my compass, my laughter, the warm hug after a long flight. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into golden memories; I love you more with each passing season, and can’t wait for the adventures ahead.
poem:
In desert dunes or rainy lanes,  
Your smile lights up my heart’s refrains.  
Together we dance, forever true,  
My love, my Liza, forever you.
